After that we will craft the Wood Pickaxe using the Make Wood Pickaxe action.

With the Wood Pickaxe ready, we will backtrack to the original table (where we have already placed a table) and use it to mine the stone that lies two blocks to the northeast of our starting point. This will be done by moving to the stone’s location (passing through the single-step north path) and performing Do to mine stone. We then place the stone on the ground with Place Stone, satisfying that achievement. Using the stone and our existing wood, we will craft both a Stone Pickaxe and a Stone Sword. We will also craft a Wood Sword with the remaining wood. 

Next, we will proceed south‑east to the cow that is four blocks away, do an interaction to eat the cow, and then place a Plant on the ground us. We will then search for an iron ore block somewhere in the vicinity; after mining it with the Stone Pickaxe we will smelt it in the furnace using the coal we already have, thereby collecting iron. With the iron and the coal in inventory, we will craft an Iron Pickaxe and later an Iron Sword. Using the Iron Pickaxe, we will dig underground or wherever diamond ore is located to collect a diamond, completing that achievement. In the course of moving around, we’ll encounter and defeat a zombie and a skeleton, and we’ll also perform a Do action on a lake or water source to collect drink. Finally, we’ll use Sleep once our energy crosses below maximum to satisfy the Wake Up achievement. This sequence of actions will ensure all 22 achievements are earned.
